problem: Completion discovered a step only by step_id while mutating the separately supplied run_id. A nonexistent step fell back to an unscoped run update.
change: Require step_id, run_id and step_path to match an existing step before updating either record.
behavior: Missing step rejects without changing run or step state.
Step belonging to another run rejects without changing either run.
Wrong step path rejects without changing run or step state.
Valid failed completion updates its owned step and run; the other run remains running.

validation.before: New database case failed: promise resolved instead of rejecting.
validation.after: All six database persistence cases passed.

limits: Does not restore the five legacy redaction/snapshot cases.
No claim of Temporal server execution or native CI validation for this local fix.
